PC03-002.name: Gabora［S-class Species］
PC03-002.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as “Kaiju”.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can destroy an opposing one-symbol Spirit/Nexus, and the effects of the destroyed Spirit/Nexus can't activate.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) When your “Kaiju”/“S-class Species”/“Seijin” depletes/destroys opposing Spirits, you can send an opposing Life to the Reserve.

PC03-004.name: Beta Capsule ［Shin Ultraman］
PC03-004.effect:
[Mirage: Cost 3]
[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By discarding this Mirage, summon an "Ultraman" Spirit card from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost.

[Main]
Draw two cards, then discard a card from your Hand. When this effect discards any "Shin Ultraman" Spirit card, and the opponent controls any Spirit, you can summon that card, without paying the cost.

PC03-X01.name: Mefilas ［Alien］
PC03-X01.effect:
This set card can't be discarded by the opponent.

[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon Cost 2/4/6 Spirit cards from your Trash, one of each, without paying the cost. For each Spirit this effect summoned, draw a card. After this effect resolves, summon this card without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - (When Attacks/Blocks)
By returning this Spirit to the deckbottom, when this battle ends, end the Attack Step.

PC03-001.name: Neronga［S-class Species］
PC03-001.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as “Kaiju”.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
By discarding a “Kaiju”/“S-class Species”/“Seijin” Spirit card from your Hand, draw two cards.

[LV2]
When this Spirit would become the target of an opposing Flash effect, by sending a core from this Spirit to the Trash, it is unaffected by that effect.

PC03-005.name: Spacium Ray ［Shin Ultraman］
PC03-005.effect:
While you control any "Shin Ultraman", this card in Hand is Cost 4.

[Flash]
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 9 or less Spirit/Ultimate. If you control any "Shin Ultraman", this effect can only be prevented by [Heavy Armor]/[Ultra Armor].

PC03-X02.name: Ultraman ［Shin Ultraman］
PC03-X02.effect:
(Can't Stack) When your Life is reduced by the opponent, you can summon this card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Ignoring the cost of Braves, destroy an opposing Cost 7 or less Spirit, and when you can't destroy, you can return a "Spacium Ray" from the Trash to your Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
At the end of battle, you can put a core from the Void to this Spirit. Then, you can return this Spirit to the Hand.

PC03-X03.name: Zetton ［Shin Ultraman］
PC03-X03.effect:
This card can only be summoned via its own effect.

When setting this card, put four cores from the Void next to your deck. Those cores can only be used by this card's effect.

[Mirage: Cost 2]
[During Set] (Your Start Step)
Send a core next to your deck to the Void. When the number becomes zero, destroy every Spirit/Nexus/Grandwalker Nexus, and those that are destroyed can't activate any effects. This effect can't be prevented by either player's effects. When you've done so, summon this Mirage without paying the cost.

[LV1]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.

PC03-003.name: Zoffy ［Shin Ultraman］
PC03-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, add an "Ultraman" card to your Hand, and you can set a "Zetton" Mirage card without paying the cost. When you do, return your originally set Mirage to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By returning another body of your "Ultraman" to the deckbottom, put a core from the Void to your Life.
